Author: Saagi
Name: Veela's Achievement Ledger
Description: Use /val to track achievements, open native Achievement entries, and passively cache observed progress.
Punchline: Track achievements with native Achievement-window assisted refreshes.
TestingChangelog: Testing-only custom-repo build: adaptive Achievement update pacing. If the native Achievement window is closed, update actions show Waiting for data with a 15 second max and a 1.0-1.5 second minimum. If the window is already open, update actions use only a 1.0-1.5 second Request cooldown. No plugin-originated progress requests are added.
